Method of Attack: Delivered as a decoy Microsoft Excel document with malicious macros to download and execute second stage malware payloads
Macro executes when user enables content, running data under Company field in document properties
Custom obfuscated VBScript (Chrome.vbs) used to infect targets with multiple chained persistent artifacts for persistence
Downloader drops DDKONG payload that exfiltrates XOR encoded victim info and provides remote access via reverse shell
DUDELL delivers KHRAT payloads with reverse shell capabilities
DUDELL delivers Derusbi backdoor Trojans that load additional modules to augment functionality
Impacted Systems: compromised computers infected by Rancor group
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Excel document with macros
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control server addresses and malware sample SHA256 hashes provided by Unit 42
